sloka: कृतोपवासं तु तदा वैदेह्या सह राघवम् ।अयोध्यानिलयः श्रुत्वा सर्वः प्रमुदितो जनः ॥२-६-९॥
transliteration: kṛtopavāsaṁ tu tadā vaidehyā saha rāghavam ।ayodhyānilayaḥ śrutvā sarvaḥ pramudito janaḥ ॥2-6-9॥

translations.english: The residents of Ayodhya were happy to hear that the scion of the Raghus (Rama) along with princess of Videha (Sita) had undertaken the fast.
